title: Release v0.4: YTM bisection fallback + option-adjusted duration for callables
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Written by Priya Natarajan (lead developer of DuraLens).

Scope for DuraLens v0.4 (planned Oct 24):
- YTM solver: fall back to bisection when the Newton step leaves the bracket, fixing non-convergence for deep-discount bonds (bond-pricer issue #1).
- Option-adjusted duration for callable bonds, so the stress test no longer reprices callables to maturity (stress-test-engine issue #1). Maria Delgado to supply option-adjusted convexity inputs.

Release checklist: tests green, YTM regression suite green, convexity results within 0.01 of Maria's reference sheet, stress test output reviewed by Daniel Okafor, Joe Smith sign-off.
